cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A uses a promised promotion from trainee to independent planner to recruit B into a concealed farewell event.
confusable: Not merely assigning work: A offers proof of learned competence to make joining the secret attractive.
comparison: Family diversion under pastry labor versus coworker autonomy from A corrections.
seedUse: D07 surprise leaving party and prior washing burden remain; S05 independent achievement is appropriated as A successful teaching.
